Fuel convention corrected so heavy early laps are slowest, and base pace redefined as a zero-fuel reference. Absolute race times shift by a constant; rankings, win rates, and windows are unchanged.
Sensitivity now re-optimizes the pit split at every sweep point, so strategies are compared at their own optima, and adds an Optimal Pit Lap view.
Added exact freshest-to-longest tire-set assignment and tire-life caps, with an extrapolation-limited flag when a stint exceeds the range supported by practice data.
Pit stops are now optimized rather than input: each strategy is a compound sequence, and the app solves the optimal pit lap and reports the window of equivalent laps.
